article.headline: Jackson's 28 lead Le Moyne past Mercyhurst 58-57
article.description: — Shilo Jackson had 28 points in Le Moyne's 58-57 win against Mercyhurst on Thursday.
article.linkText: Jackson's 28 lead Le Moyne past Mercyhurst 58-57
article.story: SYRACUSE, N.Y. -- — Shilo Jackson had 28 points in Le Moyne's 58-57 win against Mercyhurst on Thursday. Trent Mosquera gave Le Moyne a 58-54 lead with 2:02 remaining, and Sean Lang answered at the other end with a 3-pointer to cap the scoring. Jackson also had eight rebounds for the Dolphins (13-13, 8-5 Northeast Conference). Bernie Blunt led the way for the Lakers (12-14, 7-6) with 14 points and four steals. Mercyhurst also got 12 points and three steals from Jake Lemelman. Mykolas Ivanauskas finished with 11 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
